text: Kenji Rahman scored a great goal for Westport Albion at 51 minutes to make it 2-2, right after they were behind. It all started from a quick throw-in and after 4 smooth passes in about 29 seconds, Aiden Zielinski sent a perfect cross for Rahman to finish from close range. Westport Albion’s style of quick, straight passes really showed here as they controlled most of the ball and chances in the last 10 minutes, pushing hard against Kingsmoor FC’s wide defense [#976] [#982] [#983].
